requirements.requirement: The system must define a typed UI contract object that includes a phase_label field constrained to values I, II, III, or IV.
The system must include a plain_language_explanation field in the UI contract as a non-empty string.
The system must include a score_contribution field in the UI contract represented as a numeric or string value compatible with frontend display.
The system must ensure the UI contract structure is serializable into markdown-compatible content for MessageBubble rendering.
The system must define field names and structure that align with existing MessageBubble.tsx rendering expectations.
The system must accept input from the EVAL-CT-MEASURE-PHASE backend dependency without requiring additional transformation at render time.
The system must enforce that all required fields (phase_label, plain_language_explanation, score_contribution) are present in the contract before rendering.
The system must reject or flag any contract instance where phase_label is outside the allowed set (I, II, III, IV).
The system must handle missing plain_language_explanation by substituting a default fallback message indicating explanation unavailable.
The system must handle null or undefined score_contribution by displaying a neutral or omitted contribution state without breaking rendering.
The system must define the contract in a reusable typed format (e.g., TypeScript interface or equivalent) accessible to other frontend components.
The system must ensure the contract supports consistent ordering of fields for deterministic rendering in the UI.
The system must validate that the contract output can be rendered in MessageBubble without runtime errors.
The system must support extension of the contract with additional optional fields without breaking backward compatibility.
